about: Lex's cut preferences: the one place for the room around speech, the pauses at a join, the fade and the working values of the cutter and the join check. The cutter (scripts/video/cut-takes.py), the join check (join-check.py), cut-to-review.py and the review page's preview all read this file, and no script types these numbers again (tests/test_cut_preferences.py fails if one does). Times are in milliseconds unless a name says otherwise.

roomMs.why: Lex's answer of 2026-11-10: room on both sides of speech, the same before the first word as at every other cut.

linkedGapMs.why: Lex's answer of 2026-11-11: the whole silence at a join between linked phrases. He listened to the cutter's version next to the original and chose the longer pauses.

newThoughtGapMs.why: Lex's answer of 2026-11-11: the whole silence at a join before a new thought, the longer pauses he chose.

audioFadeMs.why: Lex's starting preference from EDITING-LESSONS.md, in the tools since 2026-11-04: the audio fade at every cut, as the Resolve cut's native fades. The preview fades its jumps the same.

cutterNotes.about: Working values of the cutter, not Lex's words; each is listed in the paper edit.
cutterNotes.linkedTargetMs: Where the cutter aims inside linkedGapMs.
cutterNotes.newThoughtTargetMs: Where the cutter aims inside newThoughtGapMs.
cutterNotes.newThoughtRoomMaxMs: Room per side at a new-thought join may reach this (half the aimed silence): 100-150 ms on each side adds up to 300 ms at most, so 350-500 ms of silence needs more. Every other cut stays inside roomMs. The join check allows the same.
cutterNotes.samePartOfLine: Two sentences are takes of one script line only when this share of the line's words that the shorter one says is said by the other too; less, and they are two parts of the line.
cutterNotes.shortStartWords: A dropped start shorter than this is listed, not cut: the paper edit only asks to inspect "And then I-".
cutterNotes.adLibMainWords: A line is an ad-lib only when no more than this share of its main words is in its closest script line.

joinCheckNotes.about: Working limits of the join check, not recorded preferences. It reads roomMs as the room before the first word (leadInMs) and beside every cut (speechEdgeMs).
